atAGlance: Nước la hán quả is a dark monk-fruit herbal drink, naturally sweet, cooling, and part of Vietnam’s old-school refreshment culture.
whatItIs: Nước la hán quả is la hán quả steeped into a sweet herbal drink. Expect monk-fruit drink that is dark, herbal, naturally sweet, and gently cooling.
howToEnjoy: Drink it cold as a softer alternative to soda.
howLocalsOrder: Nước la hán quả is an herbal sweet drink, so ask ít đường if you want the roots, longan, monk fruit, or cooling herbs to come through. Less ice keeps the flavor from turning watery.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Nước la hán quả belongs to Vietnam’s cooling herbal drink culture, where sweetness can come from roots and fruits rather than syrup alone.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly nước la hán quả.
orderLine.english: I’d like one glass of monk fruit herbal drink.
